address: Route du Chemin aux Boeufs, Le Mans, Sarthe, Pays de la Loire, 72100, France
description: The Karting des 24 Heures complex beside the Le Mans 24 Hours circuit. Three outdoor tracks: the 1,400 m international (CIK) circuit, the 980 m Circuit Alain Prost and the 805 m Indy-Kart circuit. Rental sessions are open to the public.
